allUsersHelp: Interface-wide cap shared by every account. Role overrides never relax this layer.
countModeHelp: Count failures too: a request consumes quota when it passes the gate. Successful only: quota is consumed after a successful response.
description: Interface quotas stack with role quotas: this layer caps one interface per user and platform-wide; the role quota caps an account's total platform usage. With package-user exemption on, requests covered by a package bypass this layer. 0 disables that window.
enableHelp: When off, this layer is disabled; QPS and role quotas still apply.
packageExemptHelp: When on, requests covered by a package skip this layer entirely so the package quota wins. When off, interface quotas also apply to package users.
perUserHelp: Per-account caps on this interface. Roles can override them below with unlimited, a signed delta, or absolute values.
roleHelp: Overrides only the per-user caps; platform totals always apply as configured. Adjust mode adds a signed delta to the interface default; a negative delta reduces the cap. An unlimited default stays unlimited. Ignore skips this layer for the role: nothing is checked or counted, including the platform total.
title: Interface quota
zeroHelp: All-zero windows disable this layer. When enabled, hour ≤ day ≤ week ≤ month must hold.
